$comment: Side number (Nr_Boczny) -> what that vehicle actually is.
No upstream feed carries this. MPK's bus_position, the city's Open Data
table 14 and Kłosok's GTFS-RT all publish a side number and nothing about
the vehicle wearing it, so model / low floor / air conditioning can only
come from a roster like this one. That makes the file the one place in the
server where a wrong entry is served as fact, and the rule for it is the
same as everywhere else here: an unknown attribute is null, never a guess.
A rider who boards expecting a ramp that is not there is worse off than
one who was told nothing.
Seeded with the tram families whose number ranges are published; the bus
fleet is deliberately empty because its numbering could not be verified
and it is being replaced wholesale (200 Conecto from 2026). Extend it, or
point FLEET_ROSTER_PATH at your own file to replace this one entirely.
Entry shape (see src/fleet.js for the validator):
kind             'tram' | 'bus' — guards against a bus and a tram that
share a side number resolving to each other.
from, to         inclusive numeric side-number range, or
numbers          explicit list of side numbers.
model            what to print. Required.
lowFloor         'full' | 'partial' | 'none' | null
wheelchair       true | false | null — is there a wheelchair space with
a way in (ramp or a low-floor door)?
airConditioning  true | false | null — saloon air conditioning; a cab-only
unit is false, because the rider is not in the cab.
years            delivery years, free text, or null
source           where the entry was checked, or null
